ownership.database: Own local database revision, modeling preparation, review increments; never edit literature task outputs.
ownership.literature: Own candidate acquisition/review only; never edit SQLite, official paper IDs, modeling code, or original library.
ownership.merge: This originating chat owns reconciliation and the merged release after both manifests are ready.

shared_rules: Normalize DOI by trimming, lowercase, and stripping DOI URL/prefix; preserve original DOI string.
Literature task uses temporary B2_001-style IDs; no new SRC/R official IDs.
Count papers, provisional materials, tests, endpoints, and admitted rows separately.
Same material/curve/source and documented reused underlying sources must stay in one validation group.
Unknown, not located, not reported, conflicting, and inherited evidence are distinct states.
Current mass normalization is separate from capacitance formula mass.
Do not use post-cycling characterization or target-derived features for pre-cycling prediction.
No scientific conflict is resolved merely by newest edit or a more favorable performance value.
No original file moves/deletes/overwrites, uploads, system/global/shared runtime changes, or research training.
New literature remains staged pending archive decision; merge candidate evidence without silently archiving or admitting it.

manifest.ready_rule: Set ready_for_merge=true only after task deliverables, checks, and limitations are saved; no claim that all candidates have been admitted is required.

merge_gate: Both tasks completed and both manifests ready_for_merge=true.
Both baseline fingerprints match this contract.
Verify every delivered file hash; existing v0.2 and original library remain unchanged.
Review proposed schema/definition changes together before applying.
Reconcile duplicate DOI/material/curve and field evidence; retain unresolved conflicts with blocked admission.
Primary new training sources must fall within 2023 through the current project date; earlier prior work is provenance evidence only, not newly admitted data.
Create merged output in its own new directory; never overwrite either task output.
Preserve database task history; ingest literature as clearly staged candidates unless all separate admission/archive requirements are satisfied.
Validate integrity, foreign keys, identity/grouping, original values, evidence, coverage counts, admission rules, and model preflight without research fitting.
Save unified release README, conflict decisions, changelog, verified counts and final merge report.

planning_targets_not_scientific_threshol.caveat: Engineering planning estimates, not proven adequacy/minimums; same-paper materials are correlated and validation is grouped by source. Data quality, coverage and grouped learning curves control readiness.
